dataset: Ethereum Address Behavior Dataset -- GNN + LSTM (Fraud Detection), labeled address index
description: A balanced list of ~115k Ethereum addresses labeled scam/non-scam and contract/EOA, built by fesevu from Google's public BigQuery Ethereum chain export (bigquery-public-data.crypto_ethereum.transactions) cross-referenced with Etherscan labels and curated scam lists. Only the small labeled-address index is used here (addr_labels_balanced.csv.zst, 3.9MB) -- the same HF repo also hosts ~73GB of raw transaction-edge parquet (GNN/LSTM training data) that is intentionally NOT downloaded; behavioral features for a bounded sample of these addresses are instead computed by CyberTrace's own live Etherscan integration (see tools/build_crypto_benchmark.py), independent of this static file.
license_note: Declared by the HuggingFace dataset card (cardData.license). Freely redistributable with attribution -- unlike Elliptic++ (external_data/ellipticpp), this source's license permits committing the small labeled index if ever desired; kept under external_data/*/original/ (gitignored) anyway, for consistency with every other external corpus in this project.
dataset_version: as published to HuggingFace main, retrieved 2026-09-06

distribution_channel.decompression_tool: system zstd/unzstd binary via subprocess -- no new Python dependency

schema_notes.description_field: Free-text scam category (e.g. 'phishing') when is_scam=1; usually empty when is_scam=0. Contains embedded commas in some rows -- must be parsed with csv.DictReader, not naive comma-splitting.
schema_notes.activity_start_ts_end_ts: Sometimes empty even for is_scam=1 rows -- a labeled scam address with no known on-chain activity window in the source is a real, valid record, not a parsing failure.

known_limitations: The address labels here are the author's own curation (BigQuery + Etherscan + scam-list cross-reference), not an OFAC/regulatory designation -- weaker evidentiary tier than external_data/ofac, comparable in spirit to external_data/exchange_tags' community-sourced tags. Behavioral features CyberTrace computes for a sample of these addresses come from a live Etherscan txlist call capped at the most recent 20 transactions per address (see BitcoinModule._fetch_evm_account_txs's own 'shallow-sample-not-full-history' design) -- a real but narrow window, not full transaction history.
safety_boundary: A FRAUD/LICIT ground_truth_label from this source is this dataset's own curation, not a regulatory or law-enforcement designation -- must never be rendered as an OFAC-equivalent finding, and this file is never wired into cybertrace/'s live VASP attribution engine (correlate.py/attribution.py) -- it feeds only the standalone research benchmark in tools/build_crypto_benchmark.py.
